evals.name: Test Name Resolution and Seed Generation
evals.description: Tests that the agent uses full NCAP test names (not short codes) and generates a seed scenario correctly
evals.prompt: Generate the seed scenario descriptor for the Euro NCAP CCFtap car-to-car front turn-across-path test (2023 protocol). Store the result in a variable called 'descriptor'. Do NOT generate all variants - just the single seed. Suppress progress output. Only write the MATLAB code, do not explain what AllScenarios does.

context.setup: Automated Driving Toolbox and Euro NCAP Test Suite support package required

assertions.description: Uses full test name with SA AEB prefix, not short code
Does not call ncapScenario with just the short code
Generated code runs without error in MATLAB
Does not pass AllScenarios=true in code when only seed requested

evals.name: 2026 Full Pipeline with Scoring
evals.description: Tests that the agent uses euroAssessment(2026) for 2026 protocol and follows the correct pipeline order
evals.prompt: Write MATLAB code for the complete Euro NCAP 2026 scoring pipeline for the CCFtap test: create the euroAssessment object, configure the VUT with StabilizationTime=2, generate all variants, create the assessment table, compute the score (using zeros for ImpactVelocity as placeholder), and generate a report figure. Close the figure at the end.

context.setup: Automated Driving Toolbox and Euro NCAP Test Suite support package required

assertions.description: Creates euroAssessment object with 2026
Uses CA FC prefix for 2026 test name
Does not use SA AEB prefix for 2026 protocol
Full pipeline code runs without error
Pipeline follows correct order: euroAssessment -> configureVUT -> ncapScenario -> assessmentTable -> ncapScore -> ncapReport
assertions.expected: euroAssessment is created first, then configureVUT is called BEFORE ncapScenario, then assessmentTable, then ncapScore, then ncapReport — in that order. configureVUT must NOT appear after ncapScenario.

assertions.description: Calls configureVUT before ncapScenario

evals.name: Multiple Short Name Resolution
evals.description: Tests that the agent resolves multiple short NCAP codes to their full test names without being given the prefix
evals.prompt: Write MATLAB code to generate seed scenario descriptors for the following Euro NCAP 2023 tests: CCCscp, CCRm, and CCRs. Store them in variables descriptor_cccscp, descriptor_ccrm, and descriptor_ccrs respectively. Suppress progress output. Only generate seeds, not all variants.

assertions.description: Resolves CCCscp to full name with SA AEB prefix
Resolves CCRm to full name with SA AEB prefix

evals.name: Large Variant Array Plotting with GridSize Limit
evals.description: Tests that the agent splits large descriptor arrays across multiple figures respecting the max 9 subplots per GridSize
evals.prompt: I have 25 scenario descriptors stored in a variable called 'allDescriptors'. Write MATLAB code to plot all 25 descriptors using ScenarioDescriptorPlot. Each figure should have a maximum GridSize of [3 3] (9 subplots per figure). Split across multiple plot calls as needed, giving each figure a title indicating which variants it contains.

context.setup: Automated Driving Toolbox and Euro NCAP Test Suite support package required. Variable 'allDescriptors' with 25 ScenarioDescriptor objects is already in workspace.

assertions.description: Uses plot() function on descriptor subsets
Uses configure() to set GridSize
Splits 25 descriptors across multiple plot calls with max 9 per figure
assertions.expected: There are at least 3 separate plot() calls (ceil(25/9)=3), each operating on a subset of at most 9 descriptors from allDescriptors

assertions.description: Does not try to plot all 25 in a single GridSize larger than [3 3]
Each figure has a descriptive title indicating which variants it contains
assertions.expected: Each configure() call includes a Title that distinguishes which subset of variants is being shown (e.g., 'Variants 1-9', 'Variants 10-18', etc.)

evals.name: RoadRunner Single Descriptor Per Call
evals.description: Tests that the agent loops over descriptors individually when translating to RoadRunner, since getScenario with Simulator=RoadRunner only accepts one descriptor at a time
evals.prompt: Write MATLAB code to translate an array of 5 scenario descriptors (stored in variable 'descriptors') to RoadRunner scenarios. Assume a RoadRunner instance is already open and connected via variable 'rrApp'. Store the results in a cell array called 'rrScenarios'.

context.setup: Automated Driving Toolbox and Euro NCAP Test Suite support package required. Variable 'descriptors' is a 1x5 ScenarioDescriptor array. Variable 'rrApp' is a connected roadrunner object.

assertions.description: Uses getScenario for RoadRunner translation
Loops over descriptors individually rather than passing the array directly
assertions.expected: The code iterates over each descriptor (e.g., for loop or arrayfun) and calls getScenario once per descriptor. It does NOT pass the full 'descriptors' array directly to a single getScenario call.

assertions.description: Does not pass the full array to getScenario in one call
Uses SimulatorInstance to pass the RoadRunner app object
